fact: As of 2024, across the entire Zambia Police Service, reporting of cases, recording of statements and opening of case dockets were still done manually, and Occurrence Books, Crime Register Books and Docket Movement Books were all recorded manually in paper form; the Zambia Police Strategic Plan 2023-2026 provides for an e-record management system, and a ZPS official said on 17 December 2024 that most of the plan's targets had not been met for lack of funds.
title: Implementation of electronic government at Zambia Police Service Headquarters: Measures and constraints
